text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I'm so weak it's almost laughable...!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To work this hard and still be on a losing 
streak?! Am I seriously never going to win 
a single race from now on?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I'm utterly ruined. Everything is 
painful. I don't think I'll ever be able 
to get back on my feet again............
choice_data_list:
First, let's rest up and recover our 
stamina.
Let's think up a new strategy together.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I lost... Being this kind to 
me, you're out of your mind..."
choice_data_list: まずはゆっくり休んで、疲れを癒やそう
新しい作戦を、一緒に考えよう
choice_data_list_en: First, take it easy and recover from the fatigue.
Let's think of a new strategy together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's caught in a negative spiral right 
now, which is why she can't bring out her 
full strength. I can't let her give up 
here.
choice_data_list: 君の能力の高さを知ってるから
貴方の能力の高さを知ってるから
choice_data_list_en: Because I know how capable you are.
Because I know just how capable you are.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Do you really... think you can win next 
time?
choice_data_list: 次こそは勝てる。ルーラーなら
choice_data_list_en: You can win next time. You are the Ruler, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
choice_data_list: ホントにホントにホントに、思ってる！
choice_data_list_en: I really, really, really mean it!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just this once for now... If I don't win 
the next one, I'm not running for a while!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I need to support her properly so she can 
bring out the absolute best of her 
abilities.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Even after thinking through all those 
options, it still didn't work out...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Then let me ask you: what do you think we 
need to do first in order to win next 
time?"
choice_data_list: Let's push all stats even higher!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: So in the end, it means more training?!
choice_data_list: 全パラメーターのさらなる底上げを！
choice_data_list_en: Let's raise all our stats even further!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
choice_data_list: 能力値を上げないと、次も同じ結果だ
能力値を上げないと、次も同じ結果だよ
choice_data_list_en: If you don't raise your stats, the result will be the same next time.
If you don't raise your stats, the result will be the same next time.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Alriiiight... I just have to do it, right? 
Fine...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looks like she's managed to get back on 
her feet. Next time, I have to make sure 
she wins!
